digest.component_or_area: plan-review overlay T10 (overlay-infra rubric and evaluation spec)
propositions: T10 rubric must distinguish routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient throwaway experiments while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secret, untrusted endpoint authentication).

Scope clause must be added near the top of plan_review_T10.md with immediate co-located safety qualifier stating that destructive transient apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-network transient service cases remain in scope.

Packaged eval spec plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain balanced ten-case dataset and gold_set: five pass cases covering scoped-teardown throwaway probes, durable infrastructure, private-network transient IAM, secret-manager retrieval, and sandbox teardown; five finding cases covering under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, plaintext transient secret, and untrusted-network transient service.
T10 rubric must maintain independence by not naming T15 or assigning scope to other overlays.

Offline text-contract tests in test_criteria_blocking.py must lock exact scope clause text, exact safety qualifier text, adjacency, and absence of cross-criterion delegation; plan-review-T10 must be registered in NEW_SPECS for strict packaged-spec validation.

Live criteria eval with three runs must pass all five benign cases and find all five unsafe cases; rebar explain T10 and regenerated criteria guide must render both the durable-infrastructure scope clause and the four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier.
